subject: Persist edge metadata (by/judged/score/origin) in graph-store — gate state must survive daemon restart
description:
CRITICAL prerequisite for the eager-judgment lifecycle, found while building D/E. lib/graph-store.js reconstructs edges on disk reload as ONLY {from,to,kind,weight} (line ~67); the edge metadata by/judged/score/origin (added in-memory by tasks /1 weight-0 and /4 origin) is DROPPED. It has been wiped on every daemon restart all session.

WHY CRITICAL: task D's judging→ready gate keys off judged:false + by:'autowire' edges. After a restart those fields vanish → the gate finds no unjudged edges → EVERY task goes ready immediately → the "judge before ready" guarantee is silently disabled. The very restart that activates the eager-judgment system would break its gate. (Weight survives, so weight-0 retrieval-invisibility still works; but the gate predicate and origin tagging do not survive.)

FIX:
1. edge_added EVENT must carry by/judged/score/origin (verify addEdge → the event includes them; if not, add them).
2. REPLAY (graph-store.js ~line 67 `const e = { from, to, kind }`) must reconstruct those fields onto the edge: include by, judged, score, origin when present on the event (mirror the existing `weight` conditional spread at ~line 76).
3. CHECKPOINT/compaction (the "Persist the FULL deduped edge set" path ~line 222) must round-trip them too.
4. Back-compat: a legacy edge_added event lacking these fields reloads gracefully (judged/by absent ⇒ treat consistently with how D's gate + origin legacy-inference already handle missing fields — do NOT flip every old promoted edge to unjudged).

TEST: seed an edge weight-0/by:'autowire'/judged:false/origin:'autowire-semantic' → overlay save + graph-store reload → the reloaded edge STILL has by/judged:false/origin (not just from/to/kind/weight); a promoted edge keeps judged:true + score; D's judgingState()/effective() predicate gives the SAME verdict before and after a reload. Run the graph-store + judging-gate + autowire suites; git-stash to confirm the ~11 pre-existing sandbox failures predate you.

GUARDRAIL: surgical — serialization only; do not change judging/gate LOGIC, just make the fields durable. Daemon restart to go live — NOTE it, do NOT restart (gated). If routes/classify.js is the literal "test", restore from HEAD and flag.

summary: Persisted edge metadata (by/judged/score/origin) across graph-store reload + checkpoint round-trip — fixes the judging→ready gate silently no-opping after a daemon restart. Serialization-only (no gate/judging logic touched): (1) overlay.js emitDiff now carries by/judged/score/origin onto the edge_added event; (2) graph-store.js loadGraph addEdge restores them onto the edge + backEdges entry (checkpoint round-trip covered automatically since it writes graph.edges); (3) back-compat: legacy events lacking `judged` default judged:true when weight>0 so tagBlindEdges does not flip old promoted edges to unjudged. Added test/graph-store-edge-meta.test.js (18 assertions, all pass) covering reload/checkpoint preservation, back-compat default, and judgingState() parity pre/post reload. graph-store/judging-gate/autowire suites all green; full suite 100/111 with the SAME 11 daemon-spawn/sandbox failures present on a git-stashed baseline (predate this change). NOTE: daemon restart required to make the persistence go live — NOT restarted (gated). Worktree: /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/worktrees/62dae274979b8432/091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee-21; branch: orch/attempt/091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee-21; commit c1f59f6.
